map.生成个数保证在 1 到 1000 之间（非法时取 1）。每生成一个 UUID v: The count is clamped to 1–1000 (1 when invalid). For each UUID v7: take the current millisecond timestamp, fill a 16-byte buffer with cryptographically secure random numbers, then write the high 48 bits of the timestamp into the first 6 bytes from high to low (successively taking the timestamp divided by 2 to the 40th, 32nd, 24th, 16th, and 8th powers and ANDing with 255, with the last byte ANDed with 255 directly); byte 7 keeps the low 4 random bits and sets the high 4 bits to 7 (the version); byte 9 keeps the low 6 random bits and sets the high 2 bits to binary 10 (the variant bits). The buffer is converted byte by byte to two hex digits, then split into lengths 8, 4, 4, 4, 12 and joined with hyphens. Toggles decide whether to uppercase and whether to append the timestamp and its corresponding ISO time after the result
